facts.value: Clears the opening timeline, one-shot guards and temporary-object slots; stores primary camera and movie-renderer GObjs; configures two 640×480 cameras with helper priorities 8 and 11 and separate gxlink_prios masks 0x800 and 0x20000; passes MvOpen.mth and gm_803DBFB4 to lbMthp_8001F410; then publishes fn_801AA0E8 in gm_804D6724 for deferred diagnostic registration.

facts.rationale: Preserves equality boundaries, branch precedence, bounded creation windows and conditional menu routing.
facts.value: Updates MTHP and copies its counter unless the previous stored timeline exceeds 5400, in which case it increments locally. One-shot guards control language-dependent sounds at 4980/5034/5100 and a main-library call at 4980. Temporary objects are created only within [454,514) and [950,974), and removed at or beyond their upper bounds. At >=5130 a title helper runs once and stores a u32 deadline from 600.0f + (400.0f + timeline). Nonzero MTHP status after title activation triggers preload once. Exit precedence is exact deadline equality, then global xC with zero MTHP status, then late Start at timeline >5500, otherwise early Start/A at <=5500. Deadline equality requests scene exit without explicitly selecting a mode. The exceptional and early paths select GM_TITLE. The late path selects GM_MENU only if gm_80173754(GM_MENU,0) returns false, but marks a new mode pending either way.

facts.rationale: Corrects unconditional-copy wording and avoids unsupported decoding of the startup table.
facts.value: Entry creates 640×480 camera/display objects, initializes title/audio helpers, and passes MvOpen.mth plus the six-word gm_803DBFB4 table to MTHP startup. It publishes a shared diagnostic-registration hook after startup. Each frame reads MTHP's counter; the stored timeline copies that value unless its previous value exceeds 5400, when it increments independently. The resulting timeline drives language-dependent sound calls, temporary presentation objects, title activation and an exact transition deadline. MTHP status, global xC and controller triggers choose distinct preload and exit paths.

facts.rationale: Separates registration publication, playback-status handling and timed exit while preserving cross-file state ownership.
facts.value: Entry resets the timeline, event guards and temporary slots, constructs the presentation, starts MvOpen.mth and publishes a diagnostic-registration hook rather than invoking it. Frame processing combines persistent one-shot flags, bounded object-creation windows, language-dependent sound thresholds and a title-activation deadline. Nonzero MTHP status causes one-shot preload after title activation; normal exit instead requires exact deadline equality. A higher-priority global-xC/zero-status branch and separate early Start/A versus late Start branches perform different cleanup and mode-selection sequences. Descriptor loading and diagnostic hook/registry lifetime cross TU boundaries.
